questions.stem: Which title fits best?
questions.explanation: The answer is “Clear Questions Help with Picnic Shopping”. Evidence: Our class plans a picnic and sends two students to buy supplies. At the shop, Mia asks how much water is in each large bottle. The label gives the amount, so she writes it on her list. Ben asks how many cups are in a packet beside the bottles. They count the cups and check that everyone in the group can have one. Then they compare their list with the money their teacher gave them. By asking clear questions, they buy enough for the picnic without taking too much.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“Clear Questions Help with Picnic Shopping”。原文依据：我们班计划野餐，派两个学生去买用品。在商店里，米娅问每个大瓶子里有多少水。标签写着容量，于是她把它记在清单上。本问瓶子旁边一包里有多少个杯子。他们数了杯子，检查能否让组内每个人都有一个。然后，他们对照清单，核对老师给的钱。通过清楚地提问，他们买够了野餐用品，也没有多拿。
